name: Nikethamide
summary: Nikethamide is a stimulant which mainly affects the respiratory cycle. Widely known by its former trade name of Coramine, it was used in the mid-twentieth century as a medical countermeasure against tranquilizer overdoses, before the advent of endotracheal intubation and positive-pressure lung expansion. It is no longer commonly considered to be of value for such purposes.

summaryZhHans: 尼可刹米是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C10H14N2O，可用作影响呼吸系统的兴奋剂。

sideEffects.en: It can cause flushing, sweating, muscle twitching, restlessness and a burning feeling. At high exposure it can cause seizures, which is why it fell out of use.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能造成臉部潮紅、流汗、肌肉抽動、躁動不安與灼熱感。暴露量高時可能引發癲癇發作，這也是它後來不再使用的原因。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能造成脸部潮红、流汗、肌肉抽动、躁动不安与灼热感。暴露量高时可能引发癫痫发作，这也是它后来不再使用的原因。

fact.en: Sold as Coramine, it was given in the mid twentieth century to try to restart the breathing of people who had overdosed on sedatives, before better methods existed. Its molecule is a relative of vitamin B3.
fact.zh: 它以商品名 Coramine 販售，在二十世紀中期尚無更好方法時，被用來嘗試恢復鎮靜劑過量者的呼吸。它的分子結構與維生素 B3 相近。
fact.zhHans: 它以商品名 Coramine 贩售，在二十世纪中期尚无更好方法时，被用来尝试恢复镇静剂过量者的呼吸。它的分子结构与维生素 B3 相近。
